scripts.setup: git submodule update --init && bun install && bun install --cwd web && bun install --cwd vendor/pocketjs
scripts.dev: bun tools/maneuver.ts sim && bun run --cwd web dev
scripts.typecheck: bunx tsc --noEmit -p web && bunx tsc --noEmit -p ui
scripts.test: cargo test --workspace && cargo test --manifest-path wgpu/Cargo.toml && bun tools/ui.ts test && bun test ./tools/icon.test.ts ./tools/wgpu.test.ts ./tools/listing.test.ts
